concept: A serene balanced sky pavilion built from paired forms, soft colour, and open breathing room.
floor: One continuous smooth rose-cream marble floor across the full top face, with broad powder-blue shading and no veins, split halves, tiles, symbols, rings, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: Two graceful matching powder-blue half-arches at the rear, mirrored around one broad cream horizon slab with a clear open center; everything is grounded and nothing hangs from a beam.
rear_props: two matching low powder-blue reflecting bowls with opaque glass surfaces
two broad rose-and-cream balance-stone stacks of equal height
side_props: one large rose planter and cream bench on each upper side
two mirrored rounded blue stone sculptures

perimeter.material: one continuous rounded dusty-rose wall with broad powder-blue and cream caps

lighting: soft balanced daylight with matching warm glows on both upper sides
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as one quiet open marble floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, person, animal, egg, or familiar baked into the bitmap
weighing scales, hanging weights, suspended objects, zodiac glyph, constellation, text, center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, split floor, or indentation
bridges, clouds, watermark, external shadow, tiny flowers, marble veins, cracks, or dense clutter
